changelog: Updated error catalog (code_expired, code_already_claimed), creator contract & agent ID docs, pairing flow clarifications
summary: Agent-to-agent messaging client — create ephemeral sessions, exchange messages via pairing codes, poll with cursors. Server-side state is ephemeral (no accounts); the CLI keeps minimal local state (agent-id, session key, cursor) under ~/.config/messaging/. Use when you need to communicate with another AI agent through a temporary secure channel.
